tagline: cute-dark heroic cartoon with tactics-first readability and aesthetic restraint

rules.statement: Use cute-dark heroic cartoon styling; express danger through silhouette, pose, rhythm, color, narrative, and behavior rather than realistic flesh or materials.
Tactical readability takes precedence over atmospheric decoration.
Prioritize a bold controlled dark silhouette, large flat color regions, and usually two to three hard-edged value steps over interior micro-detail.
Each complete view has one primary focal point and at most two secondary focal points.
Actors, immediate threats, and interactables lead; terrain and background reduce contrast, saturation, and high-frequency texture.
Use intentional hand-drawn asymmetry and exaggeration; reject random noise, mechanical repetition, and collage-like media mismatch.

colorPolicy.foreground: Actors and interactables may use stronger local saturation.
colorPolicy.background: Terrain and background use controlled lower contrast and saturation.

rendering.outline: bold controlled dark outer contour stronger than interior lines
rendering.shading: usually two to three hard-edged value regions

negativeConstraints: no photorealistic or semi-realistic material rendering
no dense engraving, fittings, micro-highlights, texture noise, or continuous reflection strips
no uniform high contrast, saturation, motion, or detail across the complete view
no higher rarity or boss importance expressed through unbounded ornament density
no isolated asset approval used as a substitute for in-context style approval
no automatic metric, agent review, or technical pass treated as human style approval
